judged_text: Admin::EmbeddableHostsController returns 500s instead of 404/422 on missing records/params: update/destroy do where(id: params[:id]).first and immediately call methods on the result, so a stale id yields nil.host= / nil.destroy and a NoMethodError; params[:embeddable_host][:host] raises if the envelope is absent; and a nil host reaches before_validation where nil.sub! raises instead of producing a validation error.
